criteria_assessment.assessment: Expert-band descriptor is supported by actual native group/fopt use, subscription verification/notifications and product traces. Do not infer a precise 5 or award total. Group member denial aborts the ACME aggregate; separately labeled fallback reads are honest and are not native mixed responses.

Multiple appropriate native bindings are supported: adapter observations, ACKs and SDT updates use native oneM2M MQTT/TLS, while operations/CSE commands use HTTPS. Expert-band descriptor has evidence, not an exact score. Loopback anonymous MQTT and local HTTP API/callback/Mcc boundaries preclude a claim of production device authentication or universal end-to-end TLS.

Proficient scenario behavior is clearly evidenced; Expert remains a qualified judgment about complex equipment/application use. Diagnostic, operator, maintenance and adapter AE identities have distinct CSE roles; cohosting them is disclosed and is not automatically disqualifying. AE count alone is not proof of independent complex applications. The non-100 damper defect prevents unqualified operational acceptance.

findings.gap_and_impact: Any acknowledged set_damper command is treated as fully open and recovered, irrespective of its requested percentage. The ACK can say 0 or 50 while observations say 100, and verification can report recovery for an unperformed target.
findings.minimum_change: Honor the requested virtual damper state and derive the documented simulated outcome from that state/profile/scenario, or explicitly constrain the supported command to the only implemented target. Keep no-recovery and missing-ACK behavior separate.
findings.product_reason: A facility operator and real agent must be able to trust that the accepted action and observed virtual device response refer to the same target.
findings.verification: Test 0/50/100 through actual command -> ACK -> later observation -> verification. Low targets must not silently become 100 or verified recovery. Retain negative cases; capture final 100 recovery on the patched revision.
findings.decision_reason: Main accepted this issue in coordination; formal disposition remains main-owned.

findings.gap_and_impact: The accepted real-model bundle captures earlier core.py and app.py hashes. Current runtime captures match this commit, but a retained old-to-new diff/impact review linking those live runs to final operational behavior is absent. The existing model runs remain valid historical evidence.
findings.minimum_change: Preserve the old bundle and record its exact runtime source/diff impact. Following the damper fix, capture one bounded positive real-model run on the final source snapshot; use reviewed impact analysis to retain unaffected stale/no-recovery evidence. No new calls were made in this review.
findings.product_reason: The release must connect model decisions and service outcomes to an identified implementation instead of presenting older captured behavior as an unconditional current-revision pass.
findings.verification: Final run records matching service/runner/client hashes, command target, ACK and later observations. Document why retained negative runs remain applicable, or rerun only affected paths.
findings.decision_reason: Main owns any permitted API run and shared budget.

findings.gap_and_impact: The extension decision document adopts PM2.5 SDT, while execution-state still says not_decided with no child gates or evidence. The final completion rule requires a reviewed decision and nonempty passed adopted child gates.
findings.minimum_change: Record adoption of the limited PM2.5 model and link individually tracked type/unit, discovery and application-use validation gates to the existing evidence and this independent review.
findings.product_reason: Preserve a precise, truthful standard-model scope and make the accepted extension resumable.
findings.verification: Execution state and extension decision agree; adopted child gates carry identified evidence/review references. Do not infer whole-model certification.
findings.decision_reason: Main owns gate-state reconciliation after all team reviews.
